SharedFlowBundle.name: ISAM-Common-ValidateSignature
SharedFlowBundle.Description:
Reusable building block: validates a SAML assertion's XML-DSig signature against its own embedded certificate (optionally pinned). Used by every SAML-bearing type (ISAM-SAML-Light, ISAM-SAML-User, ISAM-SAML-TP, ISAM-SAML-Technical, ISAM-JWT-SAML); NOT by ISAM-JWT-Token (type 6), which has no SAML assertion to validate.
INPUT variables: saml.assertion.xml string, required: the saml:Assertion XML saml.trustedThumbprints string, optional; comma-separated SHA-256 signing-cert thumbprints; empty = signature-only validation, no pinning (see the top-level README "Signature validation & trust")
OUTPUT variables: saml.signature.valid, .error, .cert.subject, .cert.issuer, .cert.serial, .cert.expired, .cert.thumbprint, .pinned saml.subject.id, saml.assertion.notBefore, saml.assertion.notOnOrAfter (parsed from the assertion DOM regardless of signature outcome)
Raises RF-SAML-Signature-Invalid (HTTP 502) itself if the signature doesn't validate; the caller never sees that case as a normal return; if this flow returns normally, saml.signature.valid is true.
